expected_divergences.why: coord_ledger.py counts file_read as an entity touch, so two sessions reading one file is contention there. The plugin counts only writes, because a read is not a conflict. Measured here so the boundary is a number rather than a comment.
Same cause as counts.contested_entities, at the detail level.

note: Kind-coverage scenario. Both analyzers know `file_read`; only Python treats it as a touch. `write_settled` is the mirror case and is not emitted here because Python's loader tolerates unknown kinds, so the divergence would be invisible.
